{{Quote|Resistance from the Umbarans has been greater than anticipated.|Jedi General Pong Krell|<ref name="The General (episode)">{{TCW|The General (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''Umbaran militia''' was the local defense force of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]], a shadowy [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Ghost Nebula/Legends|Ghost Nebula]]. The militia was comprised of the planet's native [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] people, who utilized their advanced technology that had been developed on their world to defend their holdings and attack enemy forces. Aside from the [[Umbaran soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who served as [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] units, the militia also made use of [[Millicreep/Legends|millicreep]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]], heavy [[Umbaran hover tank/Legends|hover tanks]], multi-legged [[Impeding Assault Tank/Legends|assault tanks]], and massive and mobile [[Umbaran mobile heavy cannon/Legends|heavy cannons]]. The Umbarans also employed air defense vehicles, including their technologically-unique [[Umbaran starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and combat [[Umbaran support ship/Legends|support ships]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Umbaran militia [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|fought]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in support of their world's defection to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Although the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] had hoped for the combat on the world to be quickly resolved, the Umbaran militia proved to have be more resourceful and tenacious than predicted. The Umbarans inflicted heavy casualties against their enemy's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] forces, but were eventually forced to fall back towards the [[Umbaran capital city/Legends|capital city]] of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]]. After the Republic's [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] seized a [[Umbaran airbase/Legends|key militia airbase]], [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] moved on the capital and usurped control from the Umbaran natives. Despite receiving covert assistance from rogue [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]], the militia met with defeat near their captured airbase, ending the battle for Umbara.

==Equipment==
{{Quote|We don't know what we're up against. They have weapons that we've never seen before.|[[Jesse/Legends|CT-5597]]|<ref name="The General (episode)" />}}
The Umbaran Militia were unique in the sense that they used highly-advanced weaponry that, for the most part, hadn't been seen outside of Umbara, such as [[Millicreep/Legends|millicreep]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[Umbaran blaster pistol/Legends|Umbaran blaster rifles]]. The body armor the soldiers in the militia wore was also highly versatile. It was filled with a pressurized mixture of chemicals in the form of a potent, performance-enhancing gas which heightened aggression, reaction speed and awareness. The gas was made by filtering the desired chemicals in the surrounding atmosphere via the suit, which would then transport the gas into the helmet to be inhaled. These advantages, however, came with one fatal downside. If the visor of the suit was broken by any means, the sudden pressure change would result in the oxygen mixed in with the gases being sucked out with it, thus asphyxiating the soldier and often resulting in death.

==Vehicles==
The Umbaran Militia used a wide variety of vehicles to wreak havoc on the clone army. These included [[Umbaran hover tank/Legends|Umbaran hover tanks]], [[Umbaran starfighter/Legends|technologically-advanced starfighters]], [[Impeding Assault Tank/Legends|Impeding Assault Tanks]], [[Umbaran mobile heavy cannon/Legends|Umbaran Mobile Heavy Cannons]], and [[Umbaran support ship/Legends|Umbaran Support Ships]]. The majority of these vehicles were ray-shielded which, as a result, proved the vehicles very difficult to destroy. All of these vehicles had electric and plasma weaponry. The ground vehicles could use their large, mechanical feet to crush clones under foot.
